full_name_ar: امرىء القيس بن الأصبغ الكلبي ( رضي الله عنه
bio: Quoting Ibn Abd al-Barr (al-Istiab), he was of Banu Abd Allah ibn Kalb ibn Wabara. The Prophet sent him as governor over Kalb when he sent his officials to Quda'a; some of them apostatized but Imru' al-Qays remained firm in his religion. bio: Ibn Hajar's al-Isaba fi Tamyiz al-Sahaba (entry 4361) lists al-As ibn al-Harith ibn Jaz' and refers the reader to his entry under Abd Allah. The page groups him with companions whose names the Prophet changed.
research_evidence: ٤٣٦١ ز- العاص بن الحارث بن جزء. يأتي في عبد اللَّه
dod_s: c. 680 CE (estimated from generation — no recorded date survives)
